basic_info.description: 2 bedroom + DEN! Designed by the renowned Ken Fulk, The Harrison sets the benchmark for lavish urban living. This two-bedroom, two-bathroom corner penthouse has an additional space that can be used as an office/den/nursery and a balcony offering dramatic views of the bay and Twin Peaks. This home uniquely has full views of sunrises and sunsets! The 1,589-square-foot residence features a top-of-the-line kitchen with Bertazzoni appliances, custom Studio Becker cabinetry, and polished white slab Carrara marble counters. Other high-end details include unlacquered Waterworks brass fixtures, hardwood floors, porcelain herringbone floors in baths, custom light fixtures, and closet built-ins. Also included: onsite storage cage & temperature-controlled wine storage. Enjoy 5-star amenities & services including a Grand Salon lobby staffed 24/7, a concierge, The Pantry - daily coffee, tea & breakfast pastries, a fitness center, an outdoor heated pool & spa, and proximity to San Francisco's most sought-after attractions.  Adding to the appeal, this residence offers easy access to the Financial District, Union Square, and the Ferry Building, ensuring you're always close to the vibrant heart of the city! Don't miss this chance to own this signature penthouse!
